_comment: Scenes for scripts/perf-run.ps1. chapter is the human chapter number (1..29, docs/TEST_TOOLING.md); load_seconds is how long the chapter takes to load before the measured part starts; steps run at `at` seconds into the measured part: pad is the text of a gow2_test_input line (A B X Y LB RB LT RT START BACK UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT LS RS LX= LY= RX= RY=), an empty pad releases everything. Enemies may attack an idle player in some chapters: compare a scene only with itself, on the same build and settings.

hospital_idle.note: Quiet interior, nobody touches anything: the floor for pacing and GPU cost.

hospital_walk.note: Same room, walking and turning: camera motion, texture and shadow changes.

assault_cinematic.note: Chapter 3 opens on a long in-engine cutscene: no player control, heavy effects and character shaders.

outdoor_assault.note: Open street with fire and smoke, walking forward.

chapter_load.note: Nothing measured after the load: travel only, and the whole load is the measured part (load_seconds is 0). Shows the cost of loading and of first-time shaders.
